label: Deck
description: Build a strategic update deck for Mara Heritage Bank's Q3 board session. Translate the strategic, capital, and risk material on the platform into a presentable deck: one section per strategic theme, one slide per substantive point, recommendations and decisions queued at the end.
objective: Allow the chair to walk the board through the substantive strategic update in a clear, evidence-backed sequence — decision-ready, not data-dumping.
scope: Mara Heritage Bank — full board. Meeting: Q3 2025. Confidentiality: Internal. Length: 12-18 slides.
